gameplayCandidates.role: Preferred original candidate for a visible test-room exit whose access depends on an action. Seek a single early-game sequence where the door and control are both readable and actual normal-speed movement shows the before/action/result.
gameplayCandidates.policyScope: Valve permits creative instructional or playthrough videos under its restrictions. Independently verify the capture owner's rights and exclude separately owned audio.
gameplayCandidates.accessObserved: App 620 install manifest was absent from all three configured Steam libraries checked and no Portal-named media was found in the production library search. No purchase, install or game launch.

gameplayCandidates.role: Released first-person puzzle game. The visible target across a glass boundary and a separate valid approach convey the P01 distinction between reading an objective and reaching it.
gameplayCandidates.difference: Alter uses a mirror-side transfer and a button that advances the puzzle. It does not demonstrate Portal mechanics or the actual roles of the original development team.

rightsAssessment.originalTextures: CC BY 3.0 according to the developer's notice
rightsAssessment.capturePlan: Credit Yaman Qalieh and link the original and texture license. Describe edits in the description. Use a muted original capture and verify the visible HUD, fonts and texture assets in the selected cut. Pinned sound notices are available for each named effect.

gameplayCandidates.captureBeat: Use the unchanged tutorial area in a separate local world. Confirm the target can actually be seen across the divider, show a normal approach blocked by glass, then use the normal transfer and reach/operate the target if that sequence is available. Keep relevant dialog and HUD in frame. Verify the rendered game area and decoded recording at native 1920×1080 or larger at normal speed before use.

selfAuthoredScenes.renderer: Unity for the spatial demonstration and Motion Canvas for synchronized labels
selfAuthoredScenes.baseline: Same room, fixed camera and movement rule, exit approach open and marker understated.
selfAuthoredScenes.visibility: Raise emphasis of the same marker using lighting or contrast while keeping geometry, route and camera fixed.
selfAuthoredScenes.access: Restore marker to the baseline appearance, keep camera and traversal rules fixed, and block just the approach with a barrier outside the viewing ray to the marker. Measure actual collision and verify that the marker remains visible.
selfAuthoredScenes.claimLimit: Demonstrates reachability and visibility in the authored room. Do not infer human recognition rates or attribute work to a particular game developer from footage.
